name: Money, Power, Politics with Stephanie Ruhle
original_name: Money, Power, Politics with Stephanie Ruhle
overview: Money, Power, Politics with Stephanie Ruhle is a weekday morning news and analysis program on MS NOW. The show is hosted by veteran journalist and former Wall Street executive Stephanie Ruhle, airing Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM ET.
